scanNote:
WORKBOOK 12-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (52-bet, PDF 50). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '12' va 'Holidays with a Difference'.

CHAP USTUN:
10) 'Look at the plan of Niceville Zoo, then ask and answer questions about the location of each of the [kitobda 'of the of' - takror] animals, using the phrases below.' Qiya: 'south section, south-west section, north-east section, north section, west section, north-west section, east section, south-east section, heart'. SA: Where are the birds located? SB: The birds are located in the north-west section of the zoo. XARITA 'NICEVILLE ZOO' (kompas bilan): shimoli-g'arb - tukan (qushlar); shimol - baliq; shimoli-sharq - fil; g'arb - jirafa; markaz (heart) - pingvin; sharq - kenguru; janubi-g'arb - sher; janub - maymun; janubi-sharq - ilon.
11) 'Underline the correct word(s) in bold.' 1 Sue needs to buy some/something fruit to make a fruit salad. 2 Tim called Phil's house, but anyone/no one answered the phone. 3 I'm hungry, but I haven't got no/any bread to make a sandwich. 4 Paul doesn't feel well. He isn't going somewhere/anywhere tonight. 5 I'm sure Frank is going to buy Vivienne something/nothing for their anniversary. 6 Do you know no one/anyone by the name of Marilyn Moore? 7 We had any/no mail today. 8 Jimmy does something/nothing but watch TV all day. 9 I feel like going somewhere/anywhere by the sea this weekend. 10 Is there some/any orange juice in the fridge?

O'NG USTUN:
• 'Communication: Booking a Hotel Room'.
12) 'Read the dialogue and fill in the gaps with words from the list below.' Qiya: 'double, breakfast, nights, book, bathroom, forward, view, balconies'. A: Royal Hotel. How can I help you? B: Hello. I'd like to 1) ...... a room for two, please. A: Certainly. When would you like it for? B: From the 1st to the 3rd of May. A: All right. With or without a 2) ......? B: With, please. Could you tell me how much that will be? A: The 3) ...... rooms are £60 per night, madam. B: Are there any meals included in the price? A: Yes, a full English 4) ...... is included. B: One last question - could we have a room with a 5) ......? A: Of course. All our rooms have 6) ...... with a fantastic sea view. B: Oh, that'll be lovely! A: Okay. So, that's a double room for two 7) ...... . Could you please give me your name? B: Amanda Wilkinson. A: All right then, Mrs Wilkinson, we look 8) ...... to seeing you on the 1st of May.
13) 'Use the phrases below to fill in the gaps in the dialogues.' Qiya: 'How about, We could, Would you like to, What shall, Why don't'. a A: 1) ...... we do tonight? B: 2) ...... we go out for dinner? A: Hmm. I'm not really in the mood for that. Have you got any other ideas? B: 3) ...... get something from the Chinese takeaway. A: Oh, yes! That's a good idea. b A: 4) ...... go to the Science Museum tomorrow? B: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm babysitting my little sister. A: 5) ...... going on Saturday, then? B: Yes, that would be fine.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '52'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the plan of Niceville Zoo, then ask and answer questions about the location of each of the animals, using the phrases below: south section, south-west section, north-east section, north section, west section, north-west section, east section, south-east section, heart. Example: SA: Where are the birds located? SB: The birds are located in the north-west section of the zoo.
exercises.instructionUz: Niceville hayvonot bog'i rejasiga qarang, so'ng har bir hayvonning joylashuvi haqida quyidagi iboralar bilan savol-javob qiling: south section, south-west section, north-east section, north section, west section, north-west section, east section, south-east section, heart. Namuna: SA: Qushlar qayerda joylashgan? SB: Qushlar hayvonot bog'ining shimoli-g'arbiy qismida joylashgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
JOYLAShUV - YO'NALIShLAR
  (coursebook 85-bet).

  north (N) - shimol
  south (S) - janub
  east (E) - sharq
  west (W) - g'arb
  north-west - shimoli-g'arb
  the heart - markaz (yurak)

  QOLIP: X is/are located in the
  + YO'NALISh + section of the zoo.
  ⚠ 'in the HEART of' - artikl
  bilan, 'section' siz.


XARITA:

  NW - birds (tukan)
  N - fish
  NE - elephants
  W - giraffes
  heart - penguins
  E - kangaroos
  SW - lions
  S - monkeys
  SE - snakes


⚠ 'TO BE LOCATED':

  = joylashgan bo'lmoq (majhul).

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word(s) in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli to'g'ri so'z(lar)ning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SOME / ANY / NO BIRIKMALARI
  (coursebook 86-bet).

  SOME- (tasdiq): some, something,
    somewhere, someone
  ANY- (so'roq, inkor): any,
    anything, anywhere, anyone
  NO- (inkor ma'no, fe'l tasdiq):
    no, nothing, nowhere, no one

  ⚠ IKKI INKOR MUMKIN EMAS:
  'haven't got ANY bread' ('haven't
  got NO bread' - XATO)
  'no one answered' (fe'l tasdiq)
  'We had NO mail' (fe'l tasdiq)

  1 some fruit (tasdiq, sanalmas)
  2 no one answered (fe'l tasdiq)
  3 haven't got any (inkor fe'l)
  4 isn't going anywhere (inkor)
  5 buy something (tasdiq)
  6 Do you know anyone (so'roq)
  7 had no mail (fe'l tasdiq)
  8 does nothing but (fe'l tasdiq)
  9 going somewhere (tasdiq)
  10 Is there any (so'roq)


⚠ 'NOTHING BUT':

  = ... dan boshqa hech narsa.


⚠ 'I FEEL LIKE + V-ING':

  = ... qilgim kelyapti.


⚠ 'AN ANNIVERSARY':

  = yubiley, nikoh kuni.

items.textEn: Sue needs to buy some/something fruit to make a fruit salad.
items.uz: Syu mevali salat uchun meva sotib olishi kerak.

items.textEn: Tim called Phil's house, but anyone/no one answered the phone.
items.uz: Tim Filning uyiga qo'ng'iroq qildi, lekin hech kim javob bermadi.

items.textEn: I'm hungry, but I haven't got no/any bread to make a sandwich.
items.uz: Qornim och, lekin sendvich uchun nonim yo'q.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Inkor fe'l (haven't) → 'any'. Ikki inkor mumkin emas.

items.textEn: Paul doesn't feel well. He isn't going somewhere/anywhere tonight.
items.uz: Pol o'zini yaxshi his qilmayapti. U bugun kechqurun hech qayerga bormaydi.

items.textEn: I'm sure Frank is going to buy Vivienne something/nothing for their anniversary.
items.uz: Frenk nikoh kuniga Vivyenga biror narsa sotib olishiga ishonchim komil.

items.textEn: Do you know no one/anyone by the name of Marilyn Moore?
Jimmy does something/nothing but watch TV all day.
items.uz: Jimmi kun bo'yi televizor ko'rishdan boshqa hech narsa qilmaydi.

items.textEn: I feel like going somewhere/anywhere by the sea this weekend.
items.uz: Bu dam olish kuni dengiz bo'yiga biror joyga borgim kelyapti.

items.textEn: Is there some/any orange juice in the fridge?

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the gaps with words from the list below: double, breakfast, nights, book, bathroom, forward, view, balconies.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring: double, breakfast, nights, book, bathroom, forward, view, balconies.
exercises.explanationUz:
MEHMONXONA BUYURTMASI (coursebook
  86-bet muloqot).

  I'd like to BOOK a room = xona
    band qilmoqchiman
  with or without a BATHROOM =
    hammomli yoki hammomsiz
  DOUBLE rooms = ikki kishilik
    xonalar
  a full English BREAKFAST = to'liq
    ingliz nonushtasi
  a room with a VIEW = manzarali
    xona
  BALCONIES = balkonlar
  for two NIGHTS = ikki kecha
  look FORWARD to = intiqlik bilan
    kutmoq


⚠ 'A FULL ENGLISH BREAKFAST':

  = tuxum, bekon, sosiska, loviya,
  pomidor, tost - an'anaviy ingliz
  nonushtasi.


⚠ 'PER NIGHT':

  = bir kecha uchun.


⚠ 'INCLUDED IN THE PRICE':

  = narxga kiritilgan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Royal Hotel. How can I help you?
lines.uz: Royal mehmonxonasi. Qanday yordam bera olaman?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hello. I'd like to 1) ___ a room for two, please.
lines.uz: Salom. Ikki kishilik xona band qilmoqchi edim.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Certainly. When would you like it for?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: From the 1st to the 3rd of May.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: All right. With or without a 2) ___?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: With, please. Could you tell me how much that will be?
lines.uz: Hammomli, iltimos. Qancha turishini ayta olasizmi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: The 3) ___ rooms are £60 per night, madam.
lines.uz: Ikki kishilik xonalar bir kechasi 60 funt, xonim.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Are there any meals included in the price?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, a full English 4) ___ is included.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: One last question - could we have a room with a 5) ___?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ 'a room with a view' (keyingi javob 'sea view').

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Of course. All our rooms have 6) ___ with a fantastic sea view.
lines.uz: Albatta. Barcha xonalarimizda ajoyib dengiz manzarali balkonlar bor.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, that'll be lovely!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay. So, that's a double room for two 7) ___ . Could you please give me your name?
lines.uz: Xo'p. Demak, ikki kechaga ikki kishilik xona. Ismingizni ayta olasizmi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Amanda Wilkinson.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: All right then, Mrs Wilkinson, we look 8) ___ to seeing you on the 1st of May.
lines.uz: Xo'p, Uilkinson xonim, sizni 1-mayda intiqlik bilan kutamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the phrases below to fill in the gaps in the dialogues: How about, We could, Would you like to, What shall, Why don't.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi iboralar bilan dialoglardagi bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring: How about, We could, Would you like to, What shall, Why don't.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKLIF QILISh (Making
  Suggestions).

  What shall we do? = nima qilamiz?
  Why don't we + fe'l? = nega ...
    qilmaymiz?
  We could + fe'l = ... qilishimiz
    mumkin
  Would you like to + fe'l? = ...
    xohlaysizmi?
  How about + V-ing? = ... chi?

  ⚠ 'How about' dan keyin V-ING:
  'How about GOING on Saturday?'


⚠ 'IN THE MOOD FOR':

  = ... ga kayfiyat bor.


⚠ 'A CHINESE TAKEAWAY':

  = xitoy taomlari olib ketish
  do'koni.


⚠ 'TO BABYSIT':

  = bolaga qaramoq (enagalik).

lines.speaker: a A
lines.en: 1) ___ we do tonight?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: 2) ___ we go out for dinner?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hmm. I'm not really in the mood for that. Have you got any other ideas?
lines.uz: Hmm. Bunga unchalik kayfiyatim yo'q. Boshqa fikring bormi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: 3) ___ get something from the Chinese takeaway.
lines.uz: Xitoy taomlari do'konidan biror narsa olishimiz mumkin.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Oh, yes! That's a good idea.

lines.speaker: b A
lines.en: 4) ___ go to the Science Museum tomorrow?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm babysitting my little sister.
lines.uz: Juda xohlardim, lekin ilojim yo'q. Singlimga qarayapman.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: 5) ___ going on Saturday, then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, that would be fine.

patterns.formula: Where are X located? - X are located in the [yo'nalish] section of the zoo.
patterns.exampleEn: Where are the lions located? - The lions are located in the south-west section of the zoo.
patterns.exampleUz: Sherlar qayerda joylashgan? - Sherlar hayvonot bog'ining janubi-g'arbiy qismida joylashgan.

patterns.formula: I'd like to book a room for two, please.
patterns.exampleEn: I'd like to book a room for two from the 1st to the 3rd of May.
patterns.exampleUz: 1-maydan 3-maygacha ikki kishilik xona band qilmoqchi edim.

patterns.formula: What shall we do? - Why don't we ...? / We could ... / How about + V-ing?
patterns.exampleEn: What shall we do tonight? - Why don't we go out for dinner?
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun kechqurun nima qilamiz? - Nega kechki ovqatga chiqmaymiz?

patterns.formula: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm + V-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: I'd love to, but I can't. I'm babysitting my little sister.
patterns.exampleUz: Juda xohlardim, lekin ilojim yo'q. Singlimga qarayapman.
